summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests CHM-029, an investigational oral medicine, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) that has NPM1 mutations or KMT2A or NUP98 rearrangements. CHM-029 is taken by mouth, and how often doses are given and how long treatment lasts are not stated. The study aims to find an appropriate dose, identify side effects, and learn how the body processes CHM-029.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa CHM-029, un medicamento oral en investigación, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria que tiene mutaciones de NPM1 o reordenamientos de KMT2A o NUP98. CHM-029 se administra por vía oral; la frecuencia de las dosis y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio busca determinar una dosis adecuada, identificar los efectos secundarios y conocer cómo el organismo procesa CHM-029.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory AML after treatment with standard therapies
Positive for NPM1 mutation, or KMT2A or NUP98 rearrangement
not_for: WBC count above 25,000 that cannot be kept below threshold with hydroxyurea
Extramedullary-only AML or acute promyelocytic leukemia
Current complications related to a stem cell transplant, or other cancers needing treatment
Active hepatitis or HIV, or moderate liver or kidney impairment
Baseline QTc of 470 ms or more, NYHA class 3 or 4 heart failure, or CNS disease refractory to standard treatment
